title: Failed saves replace the original data in memory
detail: All three paths commit the transformed dataset with restore, not before attempting save. A missing destination directory produces a save error, but datasignature changes and the original input is gone from memory. This contradicts the README/help promise that failure leaves data unchanged. Successful saves and existing-file rejection were separately tested and passed.
fix: Attempt save while the preserved input can still be restored, and commit the in-memory result only after saving succeeds. Add the same failure-atomicity guarantee to both conversion paths. These are recommendations; the source was not edited.

title: wxprep does not pad years to four digits
detail: For an accepted daily date 1 January 0999, both towide and rename produce x_9990101 instead of x_09990101. Discovery in tolong and wxsum requires an eight-digit suffix, so the output violates the required naming format. The problem concerns historical year values, not the modern years in the bundled climate data.
fix: Format the year with %04.0f in both name constructors and validate the supported year range; alternatively reject unsupported years explicitly before changing data and document the restriction.

title: The advertised longest-heat-spell calculation can understate the answer
kind: Confirmed functional contract defect: command/help inconsistency
detail: For daily temperatures 35, missing, 35, 35, 20, 20 with heat_threshold(30), the real longest heat run is 2. The command returns heat_start=1, heat=0, heat_end=0 under the specified D3/D4 rules, so the advertised calculation max(heat_start,heat,heat_end) gives 1. The command does not directly return a global longest-run variable. Its three outputs follow their individual definitions, as confirmed by the 729-pattern tests, but they do not provide the global longest-run functionality promised by the help. This is a functional defect against that advertised contract, not merely an outdated example or a command correctly rejecting invalid syntax.
fix: To deliver the advertised functionality, compute and expose the true longest run anywhere in the window, which is 2 in this case, and test it with internal missing days. Preserve the separately defined mid-window statistic unless its semantics are deliberately revised. Removing or narrowing the help claim would instead withdraw or limit the advertised capability; that would not implement the missing global longest-run result.

title: The manuscript describes the older interface and includes non-running examples
detail: The paper says wide is the default, omits required heat_threshold(), describes KDD as optional at a zero default, and omits wxprep, baseline(), observation-specific windows, heat spells, cuts(), minobs()/ref_min(), outstub(), and r() diagnostics. Its spell wording also predates the revised edge-missing and 0/1-break rules. Three temperature example blocks fail with r(198) for missing heat_threshold(). The submitted PDF was read alongside the TeX and is also the older presentation.
fix: Update syntax, definitions, output tables/counts, narrative, all examples, and the compiled PDF together. Regenerate the article examples from a clean executable do-file and include their actual output.

title: Required package and replication files are absent
detail: The package lists six absent paths: examples/rain_long.dta, examples/temp_long.dta, examples/hh_toy.dta, examples/wxsum_examples.do, examples/wxsum_examples.log, and examples/make_example_data.do. tests/run_all.do is also absent. The file checks produce nine failures because the example do-file/log are checked both as manifest entries and as explicit documentation promises; this is seven unique missing paths, not nine independent missing files.
tests: Six package_file failures and three documented_file failures in results.csv
fix: Include the referenced files and original test/reference materials, verify the package from a clean local installation, and ensure the distributed paths match the documentation. This audit did not fetch replacement files from elsewhere.

title: Several editorial writing and explanation requests remain unfinished
detail: The implementation substantially expands functionality, but the paper still needs a broader-use worked example, a substantive KDD explanation, explicit set maxvar guidance, the naming/rollback rationale, and forward-looking conclusions. Composite metrics and per-statistic naming were consciously not adopted in the plan; they need a clear explanation in the author response rather than a blanket completion claim.
tests: Point-by-point source review; not treated as an executable software test
fix: Prepare a point-by-point response letter with explicit implemented, demonstrated, justified alternative, and deferred responses. Do not repeat the previous review's 100% completion statement.
